title: Lead Engineer, Senior - Android Product Integration
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

**General Summary:**

The Android Product Integration Engineer plays a very important role in Qualcomm’s product lifecycle, particularly within the Linux and Android domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise and strong leadership to drive end-to-end software deliverables and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full lifecycle of software deliverables from concept to end-of-life (EOL)

* Act as the primary point of contact for internal Linux teams and external stakeholders

* Lead efforts to bring up Android on embedded devices

* Participate in the design, implementation, and debugging of system-level Android features

* Adapt and integrate forward-looking Android features and debugging functionalities into Qualcomm platforms

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field with 6+ years of relevant experience

* 2+ years of experience with programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python

* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle

• Expertise in build, integration, and release management (GNU Make, Android, Git) • Familiarity with AOSP and open-source tools

* Proficiency in scripting languages (Shell, Python)

* Experience in Android build systems and integration tools

* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills for Android system-level issues

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision • Hands-on experience in the above areas preferred

**Good to Have**

* Experience in Linux CI development and build system enhancements

* Knowledge of AI/ML algorithms

* Experience in planning and executing product software integration, testing, and release

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

title: Senior IOS Engineer
description:
### **Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled iOS/tvOS Developer to join our team and take a leading role in building and enhancing our OTT video streaming applications. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and optimize a custom video player experience for both iOS and tvOS, leveraging AVPlayer and related media frameworks. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineering teams to deliver a seamless, high-performance user experience.

  

### **What you'll be doing:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain OTT streaming applications for iOS and tvOS using Swift.
* Build and optimize a custom AVPlayer-based video player, including playback controls, UI layers, gesture handling, and state management.
* Implement features such as Multiview, DRM, subtitles/closed captions, adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS), and background playback.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create intuitive and visually polished user interfaces.
* Integrate with backend APIs for content catalog, analytics, and player events.
* Ensure high performance, low memory usage, and smooth playback on both iOS and tvOS devices.
* Debug and resolve complex playback issues, buffering/latency problems, and platform-specific behaviors.
* Write clean, maintainable code following best architectural practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall engineering standards.
* Stay up to date with Apple platform updates, new APIs, and best practices.

### **What you'll bring:**

  

* 5–7+ years of professional experience in Swift development.
* Strong expertise with AVPlayer, AVFoundation, HLS streaming, and media playback architecture.
* Proven experience building and releasing iOS and/or tvOS applications.
* Solid understanding of UI frameworks (UIKit; SwiftUI is a plus).
* Experience with performance optimization, memory profiling, and debugging tools (Instruments, Console, etc.).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks (URLSession, Combine, etc.).
* Experience implementing subtitles, DRM (FairPlay), and custom playback logic.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

### **About DAZN**

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.

**DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO:**

Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to **Make It Happen.**

Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**

Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**

At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.

If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.

Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Flutter Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Flutter Developer to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in Flutter and Dart, with proven experience building, releasing, and maintaining production\-ready mobile applications for both Android and iOS.

Roles \& Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart..
* Build responsive, scalable, and high\-performance applications for Android and iOS..
* Integrate mobile applications with REST APIs and third\-party services..
* Implement effective state management using BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, or similar solutions..
* Work closely with UI/UX designers and backend developers to implement application features..
* Debug, optimize, and improve application performance and stability..
* Handle application builds, releases, updates, and deployments..
* Publish and maintain applications on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store..
* Integrate platform\-specific functionality and native modules when required..
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-structured code..

Required Skills

* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on Flutter development experience..
* Strong knowledge of Flutter \& Dart..
* Experience with BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, or other state\-management approaches..
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and API integrations..
* Experience building and deploying apps for both Android and iOS..
* Experience with Google Play Store and Apple App Store deployment processes..
* Good understanding of native Android and iOS modules..
* Knowledge of Git/version control and mobile application development best practices..
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills..

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
